```{r packages}
# Load required packages
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(ggrain)
library(codebook)
```


### H1 Hypothesis Graph
```{r H1 Graph - prepare data}
#H1 hypothesis graphs

#Hypothesis 1:Gender will have an effect on the perception of constraints of leaving a relationship.

#IV: Gender (`Sex`) – categorical.
#DV: Perceived constraints on leaving a relationship (`relmob`) – continuous.

#use the complete-case dataset created in your previous section.

# Use complete-case H1 dataset
h1PlotData <- h1Data_complete

# Check the number of participants
nrow(h1PlotData)

# Check the number of participants in each gender category
table(h1PlotData$Sex)
```


```{r H1 violinplot}
# Create H1 violin plot
h1Violin <- ggplot(
  data = h1PlotData,
  aes(
    x = Sex,
    y = relmob,
    fill = Sex
  )
) +
  geom_violin(
    trim = FALSE,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.12,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Gender identity",
    y = "Perceived constraints on leaving a relationship",
    title = "Perceived constraints on leaving a relationship by gender",
    fill = "Gender"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)

# Display graph
h1Violin
```

```{r H1 Boxplot}
# Create H1 boxplot
h1Box <- ggplot(
  data = h1PlotData,
  aes(
    x = Sex,
    y = relmob,
    fill = Sex
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Gender identity",
    y = "Perceived constraints on leaving a relationship",
    title = "Perceived constraints on leaving a relationship by gender",
    fill = "Gender"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)

# Display graph
h1Box
```

### H2 Hypothesis Graph

```{r H2 prepare data}
#Hypothesis 2: Daily use of social media and daily time spent enhancing appearance will have a positive correlation.

#Variable 1: Daily social media use (`Time_social_media`) – continuous.
# Variable 2: Daily appearance-enhancement time (`Appearance_time`) – continuous.

#use `h2Data_complete`, which includes only participants with complete social media and all eight appearance-time responses.

# Use complete-case H2 dataset
h2PlotData <- h2Data_complete

# Check the number of participants
nrow(h2PlotData)

# Check the number of unique combinations of the two variables
nrow(unique(
  h2PlotData[, c(
    "Time_social_media",
    "Appearance_time"
  )]
))
```


```{r H2 Graph - Scatter plot}

# Create H2 scatterplot
H2Point <- ggplot(
  data = h2PlotData,
  aes(
    x = Time_social_media,
    y = Appearance_time
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Daily time spent using social media (minutes)",
    y = "Daily time spent enhancing appearance (minutes)",
    title = "Relationship between daily social media use and appearance-enhancement time"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)

# Display graph
H2Point
```


```{r H2- Jitter}
# Create H2 jitter plot
H2Jitter <- ggplot(
  data = h2PlotData,
  aes(
    x = Time_social_media,
    y = Appearance_time
  )
) +
  geom_jitter(
    alpha = 0.3,
    width = 0.2,
    height = 0.2
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Daily time spent using social media (minutes)",
    y = "Daily time spent enhancing appearance (minutes)",
    title = "Relationship between daily social media use and appearance-enhancement time"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10)

# Display graph
H2Jitter
```

```{r add regression line}
# Add linear regression line to the jitter plot
h2line <- H2Jitter +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = TRUE,
    color = "blue"
  )

# Display graph
h2line
```


```{r Save figures}
# Create figures folder if it does not exist
dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)

# Save final H1 violin plot
ggsave(
  "figures/H1_figure_Violin_Final.png",
  plot = h1Violin,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

# Save final H1 boxplot
ggsave(
  "figures/H1_figure_BoxPlot_Final.png",
  plot = h1Box,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

# Save final H2 scatterplot
ggsave(
  "figures/H2_figure_Scatterplot_Final.png",
  plot = H2Point,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

# Save final H2 jitter plot
ggsave(
  "figures/H2_figure_Jitter_Final.png",
  plot = H2Jitter,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

# Save final H2 regression plot
ggsave(
  "figures/H2_figure_Regression_Final.png",
  plot = h2line,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
